description: This file defines the OrderStatusHistory entity class, which models the historical status changes of an order in the system, including timestamps, comments, and notification status.

classes.name: OrderStatusHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the history of order status changes, including details such as timestamp, comments, and notification status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this status history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this status history record.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status at this history point.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status at this history point.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the status was added, cloning the date object to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the status was added, cloning the provided date.

methods.name: getCustomerNotified
methods.description: Returns whether the customer was notified.

methods.name: setCustomerNotified
methods.description: Sets the notification status for the customer.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to this status change.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to this status change.
